name: sakura-monorepo
description: Sakura's npm-workspaces monorepo. web/ is the production single-file app (index.html/hub.html) — deploy.yml builds and publishes web/ exclusively; it's the only application this repo has. A separate React rewrite, once discontinued and removed (see docs/handoff-prompt.md's "Current state" for that history; its code is recoverable from git history at commit 02ad593dda2ac3b6bd4daf68956f474549feaae5), used to occupy this repo under an unrelated directory also named web/ — that's fully gone now, and this web/ is the real app. worker/ is a Cloudflare Worker proposed in docs/ai-hosted-vault-design.md, not yet deployed.
